text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and drink a glass of water before breakfast. After that, I get ready for work and leave home at eight. My work schedule is quite regular: I start at nine and finish at five, with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I go to the gym three times a week because exercise helps me feel energetic. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a series, and read a book before bed. I try to keep the same routine every day, because consistency makes me feel calm and organized.
